slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the specific objective of this three-year plan, such as maximizing the total cash available at the end of year three?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and proposed total cash at year-end as the measure, which directly targets the earnings/objective definition slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or produced an equivalent final modeling state. Instead, the conversation ended after many repeated incomplete or empty questions.

summary: The agent did initially clarify the core objective, which resolves the only hidden slot, but it then failed to stop cleanly and produced many malformed repeated questions without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
